name: New Glenn
tagline: Blue Origin's two-stage reusable heavy-lift orbital launcher
description: Two-stage heavy-lift vehicle built around seven BE-4 methane engines on the first stage (the same engine Vulcan uses) and two hydrogen-burning BE-3U engines on the second. Designed for first-stage recovery via a downrange ship landing. Lifts ~45 t to LEO and is certified for NSSL Phase 3 + Project Kuiper deployments. Maiden flight NG-1 launched from Cape Canaveral LC-36 on 2025-01-16 and successfully delivered the Blue Ring pathfinder to orbit — the first-stage landing attempt was lost but the orbital insertion was clean.
best_known_for: Blue Origin's two-stage reusable heavy-lift orbital launcher — BE-4 first stage + cryogenic second
